description: Correct furniture placement and return the corrected `.arch` source with a change log. It pushes furniture out of walls, doorways and door swings, separates overlapping pieces, moves fixtures that sit in the wrong room, and snaps floating pieces to walls. A piece it may not rewrite is listed in `unresolved` with the reason. It never adds doors or windows (that is a design choice); use `suggest` for those.
name: repair
title: Repair furniture placement
